summary: Well-organized test suite with clear TDD progression covering manifest parsing (both formats), license classification, report generation, error handling, and workflow structure validation. Parametrized tests and fixture-based approach demonstrate good testing practices. Gaps: requires requirements.txt end-to-end CLI test (only package.json tested at CLI level); missing edge cases like duplicate dependencies and --fail-on-denied with zero denied packages; fixture files and workflow YAML not shown but assumed present per task instructions. Would catch most regressions in core logic but some integration paths unclear.
